paper.title_en: Multi-Centered Black Hole Index from a Superconformal Quiver Index
paper.abstract_en: We formulate a $D(2,1;0)$ superconformal index for scaling quiver quantum mechanics in its gauged sigma model description which preserves the hyperKähler with torsion geometry. These quivers describe the Coulomb-branch dynamics of multi-centered D-brane configurations in the $AdS_2$ scaling limit of type II Calabi--Yau compactifications. Using supersymmetric localization, we derive a fixed-point formula for this superconformal quiver index and identify the geometric origin of its saddle equations and fixed-point contributions. We compare the result with the configurational index of multi-centered BPS black holes, finding the same universal denominator and angular momentum weights but different saddle equations. We then examine the additional scaling contributions to the microscopic quiver index and show that, for the symmetric three-center cyclic family, the unequal-sign scaling term is exactly reproduced by the superconformal index.
